title: 橋梁預力鋼腱更換~Bridge prestressing-tendon replacement
focus: 在維持交通下安全移除腐蝕外置鋼腱、重建預力並留下可追溯的鋼腱履歷~Removing corroded external tendons safely under traffic, restoring prestress and leaving a traceable tendon record
summary: 從預鑄節塊箱梁外置鋼腱的荷載路徑與冗餘度出發，說明灌漿離析與泌水如何讓鋼絞線在低氯離子下仍然腐蝕斷裂，再處理可更換細部、舊鋼腱去張的能量控制、新鋼腱張拉與伸長量核對、全橋普查、振動與聲射監測，並以美國 Mid-Bay、Ringling 堤道與 Wando River 等橋的鋼腱更換為實例。~Starting from the load path and redundancy of external tendons in precast segmental box girders, explain how segregated, bleeding grout lets strands corrode and rupture even at low chloride, then cover replaceable detailing, energy control when detensioning the old tendon, force and elongation checks on the new one, network-wide surveys, and vibration and acoustic-emission monitoring, using the tendon replacements at the Mid-Bay, Ringling Causeway and Wando River bridges in the United States.

units.anchor: 轉向塊與錨定隔梁~Deviators and anchorage diaphragms
units.title: 外置鋼腱的荷載路徑~Load path of external tendons
units.mechanism: 預鑄節塊箱梁的外置鋼腱位於箱室內、混凝土之外，只在錨定隔梁與轉向塊處與結構接觸：錨定處把預力以集中承壓傳入隔梁，轉向塊處鋼腱改變方向，產生向上的徑向力抵銷部分自重彎矩。因為鋼腱沿全長不與混凝土黏結，任何一處斷裂都會讓整條鋼腱在整個跨度內失去作用，而不像內置黏結鋼腱只在斷點附近局部失效；這正是外置鋼腱能夠更換、也必須事先規劃更換的原因。~In a precast segmental box girder, external tendons run inside the box cell outside the concrete and touch the structure only at anchorage diaphragms and deviators: the anchorages push prestress into the diaphragm as concentrated bearing, and at each deviator the tendon changes direction, producing an upward radial force that offsets part of the self-weight moment. Because the tendon is not bonded to the concrete along its length, a break anywhere deactivates it over the whole span, unlike a bonded internal tendon that loses effect only near the break; that is exactly why external tendons can be replaced and why their replacement must be planned in advance.
units.model: 轉向力 F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2)。取有效預力 P = 2,970 kN（19 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線、0.60 f_pu）、轉向角 Δθ = 6°，F = 2×2,970×sin3° ≈ 311 kN；一跨兩處轉向塊、六條鋼腱，總向上力約 2×6×311 ≈ 3,730 kN。失去一條鋼腱，這部分向上力就少約 622 kN。數值為教學假設。~Deviator force F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2). With effective prestress P = 2,970 kN (19 strands of 15.2 mm at 0.60 f_pu) and a deviation of Δθ = 6°, F = 2×2,970×sin3° ≈ 311 kN; two deviators and six tendons per span give about 2×6×311 ≈ 3,730 kN of upward force. Losing one tendon removes about 622 kN of it. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以竣工圖與預力施工紀錄核對每條鋼腱的路線、轉向角與張拉力，並在結構模型中逐跨計算轉向力與錨定區承壓應力；現場檢查轉向塊與隔梁是否有放射狀裂縫、埋設鋼管滑出或混凝土剝落，拍照編號作為更換前的基準狀態。~Check each tendon's profile, deviation angles and stressing force against as-built drawings and stressing records, compute deviator forces and anchorage-zone bearing stresses span by span in the structural model, and inspect deviators and diaphragms for radial cracks, embedded pipes sliding out or spalling, photographing and numbering them as the baseline condition before any replacement.
units.failure: 2000 年佛州 Mid-Bay 大橋例行檢查發現一條鋼腱因錨定區嚴重腐蝕而由伸縮縫隔梁拉脫、整條鬆弛，灌漿鋼管也在斷裂時被拉出隔梁；外置鋼腱斷裂時釋放的能量還可能撞擊並損壞轉向塊與箱室內設備。~In 2000 a routine inspection of Florida's Mid-Bay Bridge found a tendon that had separated from an expansion-joint diaphragm after severe anchorage-zone corrosion and gone completely slack, with its grouted steel pipe pulled out of the diaphragm during the rupture; the energy released by a breaking external tendon can also strike and damage deviators and equipment inside the box.
units.misconception: 外置鋼腱斷一條只影響斷點附近，其餘跨段照常有預力。~When one external tendon breaks, only the region near the break loses prestress.
units.practice: 設計時就要在說明中寫明每一條外置鋼腱都可在交通管制下單獨更換，並在計算書逐跨列出移除任一條鋼腱時的應力檢核與所需交通限制，讓日後的管理單位不必重新推導。~State in the design that every external tendon can be replaced individually under traffic management, and list in the calculations, span by span, the stress check with any one tendon removed and the traffic restriction it requires, so the future owner does not have to re-derive it.

units.anchor: 節塊接縫底緣應力~Bottom-fibre stress at segment joints
units.title: 移除一條鋼腱時的接縫應力~Joint stress with one tendon removed
units.mechanism: 預鑄節塊之間的接縫通常沒有鋼筋穿越，接縫能否保持閉合完全依賴預力在底緣留下的壓應力。正常使用時，預力的軸壓與偏心彎矩抵銷恆載與活載彎矩，使底緣仍保有少量壓應力儲備；更換鋼腱時必須先把舊鋼腱去張，等於在施工期間主動讓該跨少一條鋼腱數週。因此更換工程的第一個問題不是怎麼切，而是少一條鋼腱時接縫會不會出現拉應力而張開，以及需要多少交通管制或臨時預力才能避免。~Joints between precast segments usually have no reinforcement crossing them, so whether a joint stays closed depends entirely on the compression that prestress leaves in the bottom fibre. In service, the axial prestress and its eccentric moment offset dead- and live-load moments, leaving a small compressive reserve; replacing a tendon means deliberately detensioning the old one, so the span works one tendon short for weeks. The first question of a replacement is therefore not how to cut, but whether the joints decompress and open with one tendon missing, and how much traffic restriction or temporary prestress prevents it.
units.model: σ_b = −P/A − P·e/S_b + M/S_b。設 A = 6.0 m²、S_b = 3.5 m³、e = 1.2 m、M = 30 MN·m。六條鋼腱 P = 17.82 MN：σ_b = −2.97 − 6.11 + 8.57 ≈ −0.51 MPa（受壓）；去掉一條後 P = 14.85 MN：σ_b = −2.48 − 5.09 + 8.57 ≈ +1.00 MPa（受拉，接縫可能張開）。數值為教學假設。~σ_b = −P/A − P·e/S_b + M/S_b. Take A = 6.0 m², S_b = 3.5 m³, e = 1.2 m and M = 30 MN·m. With six tendons, P = 17.82 MN gives σ_b = −2.97 − 6.11 + 8.57 ≈ −0.51 MPa (compression); with one removed, P = 14.85 MN gives σ_b = −2.48 − 5.09 + 8.57 ≈ +1.00 MPa (tension, the joint may open). Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以施工階段模型逐步模擬「舊鋼腱去張、空缺期、新鋼腱張拉」三個狀態，檢查每個接縫在設計活載與溫度梯度下的應力；現場在接縫兩側安裝裂縫計或位移計，去張期間連續記錄接縫開口，超過預定警戒值（例如 0.1 mm）即停工檢討。~Model the three construction states, old tendon detensioned, gap period and new tendon stressed, and check every joint under design live load and thermal gradient; on site, fit crack gauges or displacement transducers across joints and log opening continuously during detensioning, stopping work for review if a preset alert value such as 0.1 mm is exceeded.
units.failure: 若沒有先算出少一條鋼腱的狀態就開放全部交通，接縫可能在重車通過時反覆張開又閉合，環氧樹脂接縫劣化、水氣進入，反而加速鄰近鋼腱的腐蝕，使一次更換演變成連鎖問題。~Skipping the one-tendon-short check and keeping full traffic lets joints open and close under every heavy truck, degrading the epoxy joints and admitting moisture, which accelerates corrosion of the neighbouring tendons and turns one replacement into a chain of problems.
units.misconception: 只要其餘鋼腱沒斷，更換期間的橋就和平常一樣安全。~As long as the other tendons are intact, the bridge is as safe as usual during a replacement.
units.practice: 更換計畫應附上每一跨、每一條鋼腱移除時所需的交通限制表（車道封閉、重車禁行或限速），以及必要時的臨時預力棒配置，由原設計者或獨立審查工程師簽認後才能動工。~The replacement plan should attach, for every span and every tendon, a table of required traffic restrictions (lane closure, heavy-vehicle ban or speed limit) and any temporary prestressing bars, signed by the original designer or an independent checking engineer before work starts.

units.anchor: 灌漿空隙與泌水~Grout voids and bleed water
units.title: 鋼絞線腐蝕與殘餘強度~Strand corrosion and residual strength
units.mechanism: 灌漿鋼腱的防蝕依靠水泥漿的高鹼性與完整包覆，但灌漿若離析、泌水，會在鋼腱高點、錨頭與轉向處留下空隙與軟弱漿體。FHWA 對 Mid-Bay 的彙整指出，即使灌漿氯離子含量很低，碳化、離析灌漿與多餘泌水仍會在氧氣與水氣存在下造成快速腐蝕；Wando River 橋與 Ringling 堤道橋也都找到離析、粉狀或濕軟的灌漿帶。腐蝕常集中在少數鋼絞線，鋼絲先在局部斷裂，灌漿又把附近未斷的鋼絲綁在一起，使殘存鋼絲在斷點附近承擔更高應力。~Grouted tendons rely on the high alkalinity and full encapsulation of cement grout, but segregated or bleeding grout leaves voids and soft paste at high points, anchorages and deviators. FHWA's review of Mid-Bay concluded that carbonation, segregated grout and excess bleed water caused rapid corrosion in the presence of oxygen and moisture even though grout chloride was very low; investigations at the Wando River and Ringling Causeway bridges also found segregated, chalky or soft wet grout bands. Corrosion usually concentrates in a few strands, wires break locally, and the grout ties nearby intact wires together so that the survivors carry higher stress near the break.
units.model: 19 股鋼腱 A_ps = 19×140 = 2,660 mm²、f_pu = 1,860 MPa，極限力 F_pu ≈ 4,950 kN，有效預力 0.60F_pu ≈ 2,970 kN。若灌漿在斷點附近把力量局部鎖住，殘存面積比降到 0.60/0.90 ≈ 0.67 時殘存鋼絲達降伏（約斷 6.3 股），降到 0.60 時達極限（約斷 7.6 股）。數值為教學假設。~A 19-strand tendon has A_ps = 19×140 = 2,660 mm² and f_pu = 1,860 MPa, so F_pu ≈ 4,950 kN and the effective prestress 0.60F_pu ≈ 2,970 kN. If the grout locks the force locally near a break, the survivors yield when the remaining area ratio falls to 0.60/0.90 ≈ 0.67 (about 6.3 strands lost) and reach ultimate at 0.60 (about 7.6 strands lost). Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在鋼腱高點、錨頭後方與轉向塊兩側鑽小孔，以內視鏡觀察空隙與鋼絲表面，取灌漿樣本做氯離子、硫酸根、含水率與碳化試驗；鋼絲樣本則量測截面損失與腐蝕型態，每一筆結果都標註到鋼腱編號與位置。~Drill small holes at tendon high points, behind anchorages and on both sides of deviators, inspect voids and wire surfaces with a borescope, and test grout samples for chloride, sulfate, moisture content and carbonation; measure section loss and corrosion morphology on wire samples, and tag every result to the tendon number and location.
units.failure: Wando River 橋第二次失效的鋼腱共 133 根鋼絲中，約 80.5% 因腐蝕斷裂，其餘在截面減少後因過載拉斷，顯示局部腐蝕累積到臨界點後，最後的斷裂是突發的；一支未封閉、通到橋面的灌漿排氣管把水引入隔梁，是調查確認的進水路徑。~In the second Wando River Bridge failure, about 80.5% of the tendon's 133 wires had ruptured by corrosion and the rest by overstress on the reduced area, showing that once local corrosion reaches a threshold the final rupture is sudden; an open grout vent tube running up to the deck and carrying water into a diaphragm was a confirmed water path.
units.misconception: 只要灌漿的氯離子含量很低，鋼腱就不會腐蝕。~If grout chloride content is very low, the tendon cannot corrode.
units.practice: 檢測取樣要涵蓋高點、低點、錨頭與轉向處，並把排氣管與灌漿孔是否封閉列入每次巡檢；任何開放的排氣管或積水的錨頭帽都視為缺陷，限期封堵並追查同一灌漿批次的鋼腱。~Sampling must cover high points, low points, anchorages and deviators, and every inspection should check that vents and grout ports are sealed; treat any open vent or water-filled anchor cap as a defect, seal it within a set deadline and investigate the tendons grouted in the same batch.

units.anchor: 雙層包覆與擴口轉向~Double envelope and diabolo
units.title: 可更換鋼腱的細部設計~Detailing for replaceable tendons
units.mechanism: 傳統做法在轉向塊與隔梁內埋設剛性鋼管，再以套管接上外露的 HDPE 套管並一起灌漿；更換時灌漿把鋼腱與鋼管黏成一體，抽出時常損壞混凝土。FHWA 2019 年的可更換灌漿外置鋼腱指引提出「雙層包覆」概念：在轉向塊與隔梁內以喇叭狀的擴口模形成空腔，讓鋼腱連同套管只靠承壓傳力、不與混凝土黏結，錨頭也用導管或雙喇叭管隔開，舊鋼腱可以整條抽出。AASHTO LRFD 節塊橋條文另要求預留臨時與未來追加鋼腱的錨座與孔道，作為更換期間或日後補強的備援。~Traditional details embed rigid steel pipes in deviators and diaphragms, couple them to exposed HDPE duct and grout everything together; on replacement the grout binds tendon and pipe into one piece, so extraction often damages the concrete. FHWA's 2019 guide on replaceable grouted external tendons proposes a double-envelope concept: trumpet-shaped diabolo voids in deviators and diaphragms let the tendon and its duct transfer force by bearing only, with no bond to the concrete, and guide pipes or double trumpets isolate the anchorages, so the old tendon can be pulled out whole. AASHTO LRFD segmental provisions also require provisional and future tendon anchorages and ducts, which serve as a reserve during replacement or later strengthening.
units.model: FHWA 指引建議擴口出口角 = 轉向角 + 3°。轉向角 6° 時出口角取 9°；19 股鋼腱最小轉向半徑約 9.8 ft（約 3.0 m），弧長 s = R·θ = 3.0×(9×π/180) ≈ 0.47 m。若一跨六條鋼腱總力 17.82 MN，臨時預力容量至少 5%，約 0.89 MN。數值為教學假設。~The FHWA guide recommends a diabolo exit angle equal to the deviation angle plus 3°. For a 6° deviation the exit angle is 9°; with a minimum deviator radius of about 9.8 ft (about 3.0 m) for a 19-strand tendon, the arc length is s = R·θ = 3.0×(9×π/180) ≈ 0.47 m. For six tendons totalling 17.82 MN in a span, a provisional capacity of at least 5% is about 0.89 MN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 設計審查時逐一核對擴口半徑、出口角與內徑（FHWA 建議內徑至少比套管外徑大 1/2 in），並以足尺試體或首件施作證明可以抽出；施工時量測擴口模成形面的平整度，檢查是否有超過 1/8 in 的凸起會刮傷套管。~In design review, check each diabolo's radius, exit angle and inside diameter (FHWA recommends at least 1/2 in larger than the duct outside diameter), and prove extraction with a full-scale mock-up or first-article trial; during construction, survey the formed surfaces for irregularities above 1/8 in that would scrape the duct.
units.failure: 若轉向塊內的鋼管與灌漿成為一體，更換時只能以鑿除或鑽心方式取出舊鋼腱，轉向塊被削弱、鋼筋外露，新鋼腱只好改走外加的轉向座，工期與交通管制都大幅延長。~If the pipe and grout inside a deviator act as one piece, the old tendon can only be removed by chipping or coring, weakening the deviator and exposing reinforcement; the new tendon then has to run over an added deviation saddle, greatly extending the work and the traffic management.
units.misconception: 外置鋼腱因為看得到，天生就可以更換，不需要特別的細部。~Because external tendons are visible, they are inherently replaceable without special detailing.
units.practice: 圖說要標示每條鋼腱張拉端與固定端的淨空：FHWA 指引引用千斤頂端部淨空約 6 至 7 ft、固定端至少 2 ft 6 in；箱室內的照明、排水管與檢查走道不得佔用這些空間。~Show the stressing-end and dead-end clearances of every tendon on the drawings: the FHWA guide cites a jack envelope of about 6 to 7 ft at the stressing end and at least 2 ft 6 in at the dead end, and box-cell lighting, drain pipes and inspection walkways must not intrude into these spaces.

units.anchor: 逐股切斷與夾具~Strand-by-strand cutting and clamps
units.title: 舊鋼腱去張與能量釋放~Detensioning and energy release
units.mechanism: 仍帶殘餘力的鋼腱儲存大量彈性能，若直接在錨頭燒斷楔片，鋼絞線與楔片可能從錨頭後方彈出。FDOT 在 2000 年處理 Mid-Bay 第 28 跨殘餘力約 500 kips 的鋼腱時，先剝除套管與灌漿，每約 4 ft 裝一組 U 型螺栓夾具限制甩動，再以電動砂輪機在錨頭與轉向處交替逐股切斷，使轉向塊兩側不平衡的斷股不超過一股，最後以 20,000 psi 水刀與單股千斤頂取出殘段。灌漿把鋼絲局部綁在一起，每切一股，鄰近鋼絲的應力就上升，因此切斷順序必須事先分析。~A tendon with residual force stores large elastic energy, and burning out wedges at the anchorage can eject strands and wedges out of the back of the anchor. In 2000, dealing with a Mid-Bay span 28 tendon still carrying about 500 kips, FDOT removed the duct and grout, fitted U-bolt clamps about every 4 ft to restrain whip, cut strands one at a time with an electric abrasive saw, alternating between anchorage and deviator so that no more than one cut strand was out of balance across a deviator, then removed the remnants with a 20,000 psi water jet and a monostrand jack. Because grout ties wires together locally, each cut raises the stress in neighbouring wires, so the cutting sequence must be analysed beforehand.
units.model: 單股彈性能 U = P²L/(2EA)。取每股 156 kN、自由長度 60 m、E = 195 GPa、A = 140 mm²：U = 156,000²×60/(2×195×10⁹×140×10⁻⁶) ≈ 26.7 kJ；整條 19 股、2,970 kN 約 510 kJ。理想化地假設夾具能鎖住鋼絞線，切斷時參與彈出的只剩夾具間 1.2 m，釋放能量約 0.53 kJ。數值為教學假設。~Elastic energy in one strand is U = P²L/(2EA). With 156 kN per strand, a free length of 60 m, E = 195 GPa and A = 140 mm², U = 156,000²×60/(2×195×10⁹×140×10⁻⁶) ≈ 26.7 kJ; the whole 19-strand tendon at 2,970 kN stores about 510 kJ. Idealising that the clamps lock the strand, only the 1.2 m between clamps takes part in the recoil, releasing about 0.53 kJ. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 去張前以分析確認每次切斷後殘存鋼絲的應力：FDOT 的分析指出，若灌漿局部鎖住且連續切斷，約 7 次後殘存鋼絞線降伏、約 15 次達極限。現場依切斷順序表、夾具扭力紀錄與人員禁入區逐項簽核，並在錨頭後方設置鋼製擋板。~Before detensioning, analyse the stress in the surviving wires after each cut: FDOT's analysis showed that with grout locking strands locally and consecutive cuts, survivors would yield after about 7 cuts and reach ultimate after about 15. On site, sign off the cutting-sequence sheet, clamp torque records and personnel exclusion zones item by item, and install a steel containment plate behind the anchorage.
units.failure: 在箱梁內以火焰燒斷鋼腱，部分加熱的鋼材仍帶應力且通風不良；若順序失衡，在同一側連續切斷，會對轉向塊施加不平衡力，使轉向塊開裂或埋設鋼管滑動。~Flame-cutting inside a box girder leaves partly heated steel still under stress in poor ventilation; an unbalanced sequence with consecutive cuts on one side applies unbalanced force to a deviator that can crack it or slide its embedded pipe.
units.misconception: 鋼腱已經斷了一部分，剩下的鋼絞線可以直接在錨頭燒斷。~Once part of a tendon has broken, the remaining strands can simply be torched off at the anchorage.
units.practice: 去張屬高能量釋放的危險作業，施工計畫須列出切斷順序、夾具間距、人員禁入區與停止條件，由業主、審查工程師與承包商安全主管共同核准後才能開始；本課只說明檢核邏輯，不構成作業許可。~Detensioning is a hazardous high-energy operation: the method statement must list the cutting sequence, clamp spacing, exclusion zones and stop criteria, and be approved jointly by the owner, the checking engineer and the contractor's safety lead before work starts; this course explains the checking logic only and is not an operating permit.

units.anchor: 千斤頂讀值與伸長量~Jack pressure and elongation
units.title: 新鋼腱張拉與伸長量控制~Stressing the new tendon and elongation control
units.mechanism: 新鋼腱穿入原路線後，以多股千斤頂從張拉端施加預力，力量沿路線經過每一處轉向時因摩擦而遞減。張拉採「力量與伸長量雙重核對」：千斤頂油壓換算的力量決定目標，量到的伸長量則反映鋼材彈性模數、摩擦與錨定滑移是否符合假設。外置鋼腱長度可達百公尺以上，伸長量常超過千斤頂行程，需要多次回程，每次回程的楔片咬合都會損失少許伸長量。~After the new tendon is threaded along the original path, a multistrand jack applies force at the stressing end, and the force decays by friction at each deviator along the route. Stressing is controlled by a dual check of force and elongation: the jack pressure converted to force sets the target, while the measured elongation shows whether the steel modulus, friction and anchor set match the assumptions. External tendons can exceed a hundred metres, so elongation often exceeds the jack stroke and needs several restrokes, each wedge seating losing a little elongation.
units.model: 張拉力 P_j = 2,660 mm²×1,450 MPa ≈ 3,857 kN；μ = 0.25、總轉角 α = 0.20 rad，固定端 P = P_j·e^(−μα) ≈ 3,669 kN，平均約 3,763 kN。L = 120 m、E = 195 GPa：ΔL = P_avg·L/(A·E) = 3,763,000×120/(2.66×10⁻³×195×10⁹) ≈ 0.87 m，千斤頂行程 250 mm 需約 4 次。數值為教學假設。~Jacking force P_j = 2,660 mm²×1,450 MPa ≈ 3,857 kN; with μ = 0.25 and total angle α = 0.20 rad, the dead-end force is P = P_j·e^(−μα) ≈ 3,669 kN and the average about 3,763 kN. For L = 120 m and E = 195 GPa, ΔL = P_avg·L/(A·E) = 3,763,000×120/(2.66×10⁻³×195×10⁹) ≈ 0.87 m, so a 250 mm jack stroke needs about 4 strokes. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 千斤頂與壓力錶必須在有效期限內以校正荷重計配對校正；張拉時分級記錄油壓與伸長量，扣除初始鬆弛段後外推實際伸長量，與計算值比較，差異超出規範允差（常見 ±5% 至 ±7%）時停工查明摩擦、卡住或鋼絞線滑移。~Jacks and gauges must be calibrated as a pair against a load cell within their validity period; record pressure and elongation in stages, extrapolate the true elongation after removing the initial slack range and compare it with the calculated value, stopping to investigate friction, binding or strand slip if the difference exceeds the specified tolerance, commonly ±5% to ±7%.
units.failure: 若轉向處的套管在穿索時被刮破或擠扁，摩擦大增，張拉端達到目標力量但固定端力量不足，伸長量偏短；只看油壓的人會以為合格，實際上該跨預力不足，接縫底緣的壓應力儲備已被吃掉。~If the duct at a deviator was scraped or crushed during threading, friction rises sharply: the stressing end reaches its target force but the dead end is short and the elongation comes up low. Anyone watching only the gauge would accept it, yet the span is under-prestressed and the joint compression reserve is gone.
units.misconception: 千斤頂油壓達到目標值，就證明整條鋼腱的力量都正確。~Reaching the target jack pressure proves the force is correct along the whole tendon.
units.practice: 新鋼腱在灌漿或注入填充材前設置停留點：由監造確認伸長量紀錄、錨定滑移量與兩端力量，並保留至少一次再張拉的機會；若業主選用可再張拉的柔性填充材，須在交接文件寫明材料與再張拉程序。~Set a hold point before the new tendon is grouted or filled: the resident engineer confirms the elongation record, anchor set and end forces, keeping at least one opportunity to restress; if the owner chooses a restressable flexible filler, record the material and restressing procedure in the handover documents.

units.anchor: 磁通洩漏掃描與鑽孔內視鏡~MFL scans and borescope holes
units.title: 全橋鋼腱普查與抽樣~Network-wide tendon survey and sampling
units.mechanism: 發現一條鋼腱斷裂後，管理單位最需要知道的是還有多少條處於相同狀態。外露的外置鋼腱可用磁通洩漏（MFL）設備沿套管移動，偵測斷絲與截面損失造成的磁場擾動；被混凝土包住的錨頭與轉向段則需要鑽孔內視鏡、敲擊與取樣。2000 年 Mid-Bay 事件後，FDOT 以內視鏡檢查全部 1,728 個錨頭並使用 MFL，最後更換 846 條鋼腱中的 11 條。決定更換清單與優先順序的應是普查結果，而不只是已經斷的那一條。~After one tendon breaks, the owner most needs to know how many others are in the same state. Exposed external tendons can be scanned by magnetic flux leakage (MFL) equipment moved along the duct, detecting field disturbances from wire breaks and section loss; anchorages and deviator zones hidden in concrete need borescope holes, sounding and sampling. After the 2000 Mid-Bay event FDOT borescoped all 1,728 anchorages and used MFL, eventually replacing 11 of 846 tendons. The survey, not just the broken tendon, should set the replacement list and priorities.
units.model: 若推估 p = 5% 的鋼腱帶有嚴重缺陷，隨機抽查 n 條至少找到一條的機率 P = 1 − (1 − p)ⁿ。n = 60 時 P = 1 − 0.95⁶⁰ ≈ 1 − 0.046 = 95.4%；要達 99% 需 n = ln0.01/ln0.95 ≈ 90 條。數值為教學假設。~If an estimated p = 5% of tendons carry a serious defect, the probability that a random sample of n finds at least one is P = 1 − (1 − p)ⁿ. For n = 60, P = 1 − 0.95⁶⁰ ≈ 1 − 0.046 = 95.4%; reaching 99% needs n = ln0.01/ln0.95 ≈ 90 tendons. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: MFL 需先在含已知缺陷的標定試體上確認可偵測的最小截面損失，現場訊號再與內視鏡或開窗結果交叉比對；抽樣計畫依 FHWA 灌漿缺陷指引的統計方法決定數量與位置，並偏重高點、錨頭與曾有漏水紀錄的節段。~Calibrate the MFL equipment on a specimen with known defects to confirm the smallest detectable section loss, then cross-check field signals against borescope or opened-window findings; set sample numbers and locations with the statistical approach in FHWA's grout-defect guidelines, weighted toward high points, anchorages and segments with a history of leakage.
units.failure: MFL 在錨頭、轉向鋼管與鋼筋密集處訊號會受干擾，若把「沒有訊號」當成「沒有缺陷」，最可能腐蝕的錨定區反而沒有被檢查；只做目視而不鑽孔，也看不到套管內的空隙與粉狀灌漿。~MFL signals are disturbed at anchorages, deviator pipes and congested reinforcement, so treating no signal as no defect leaves the anchorage zones, where corrosion is most likely, unchecked; visual inspection without drilling cannot see voids and chalky grout inside the duct.
units.misconception: 只要套管外觀沒有裂縫，裡面的鋼腱就一定完好。~If the duct shows no cracks outside, the tendon inside must be sound.
units.practice: 普查資料以鋼腱編號、跨號與錨頭編號建立唯一識別，並記錄每一個鑽孔的位置與封孔材料；所有檢測孔都必須以相容的灌漿或環氧樹脂封閉，避免檢查本身成為新的進水路徑。~Index survey data by unique tendon, span and anchorage numbers and record every drilled hole's location and sealing material; seal all inspection holes with compatible grout or epoxy so the inspection itself does not create a new water path.

units.anchor: 鋼腱自振頻率~Tendon natural frequency
units.title: 以振動估計鋼腱殘餘張力~Estimating residual tendon force by vibration
units.mechanism: 外置鋼腱在兩個轉向塊之間像一根拉緊的弦，張力越大，橫向自振頻率越高。以小錘輕敲或環境振動激發，用加速度計量到基頻即可反推張力，不必切開套管就能比較各條鋼腱的力量；FDOT 在 Mid-Bay 的狀況評估中也使用了南佛羅里達大學發展的振動測試技術。灌漿後的鋼腱具有彎曲勁度，轉向處也不是理想鉸接，因此絕對值需要校正，最可靠的用法是比較同一跨各條鋼腱或同一條鋼腱的歷年變化。~Between two deviators an external tendon behaves like a taut string: the higher the tension, the higher its transverse natural frequency. Excited by a light hammer tap or ambient vibration, the fundamental frequency measured with an accelerometer can be inverted to tension, letting engineers compare tendon forces without opening the duct; FDOT's Mid-Bay condition assessment also used a vibration testing technique developed at the University of South Florida. A grouted tendon has bending stiffness and deviators are not ideal pins, so absolute values need calibration; the most reliable use is comparing tendons within one span, or one tendon year by year.
units.model: 弦振動 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。自由長度 L = 20 m，單位長質量 m ≈ 鋼絞線 19×1.10 + 灌漿 9.9 + 套管 1.5 ≈ 32.3 kg/m；T = 2,970 kN 時 f₁ = (1/40)×√(2,970,000/32.3) ≈ 7.6 Hz。因 f ∝ √T，張力降 30% 時頻率降為約 6.3 Hz。數值為教學假設。~String vibration gives f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m). With a free length L = 20 m and a mass per metre m ≈ strand 19×1.10 + grout 9.9 + duct 1.5 ≈ 32.3 kg/m, T = 2,970 kN gives f₁ = (1/40)×√(2,970,000/32.3) ≈ 7.6 Hz. Because f ∝ √T, a 30% loss of tension lowers it to about 6.3 Hz. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以加速度計量取至少前三個模態，檢查 f_n 是否隨 n 線性增加以確認弦模型適用，偏離時改用含彎曲勁度的模型；以剛完成張拉、力量已知的新鋼腱做現場標定，再換算同跨其他鋼腱的張力，差異超過約 10% 者列為優先開窗檢查對象。~Record at least the first three modes and check that f_n grows linearly with n, confirming the string model, and switch to a model with bending stiffness if it does not; calibrate on site with a freshly stressed tendon of known force, convert the frequencies of the other tendons in the span, and prioritise any that differ by more than about 10% for opening and inspection.
units.failure: 若把轉向處當成理想支點而忽略灌漿鋼腱的彎曲勁度，算出的張力會偏高，讓已失去部分鋼絲的鋼腱看起來正常；溫度變化也會改變張力與頻率，直接比較不同季節的資料可能誤判。~Treating deviators as ideal supports and ignoring the bending stiffness of a grouted tendon overestimates tension, making a tendon that has lost wires look normal; temperature also changes tension and frequency, so directly comparing data from different seasons can mislead.
units.misconception: 鋼腱振動頻率只要有變化，就一定是斷了鋼絲。~Any change in a tendon's vibration frequency must mean broken wires.
units.practice: 為每一條鋼腱建立頻率指紋：施工或更換完成時量一次作為基準，之後在相近溫度下定期複量；量測點位、激振方式與感測器型號寫入檢測程序，以免換了檢測人員就換了方法。~Give every tendon a frequency fingerprint: measure once at completion or after replacement as the baseline, then re-measure periodically at similar temperatures; write the measurement points, excitation method and sensor model into the inspection procedure so the method does not change with the inspector.

units.anchor: 真空灌注與錨頭保護帽~Vacuum injection and anchor caps
units.title: 灌漿空隙修補與錨頭防護~Grout-void repair and anchorage protection
units.mechanism: 不是每一條有空隙的鋼腱都需要更換：鋼絲完好但灌漿不滿時，可用真空輔助灌注先把空隙抽成負壓，再注入低泌水灌漿或樹脂填滿，阻斷水氣與氧氣。Mid-Bay 在 2000 年事件後即對錨頭空隙進行真空再灌漿，後續整治也包含鋼腱包覆與錨頭保護。錨頭是最容易進水的位置，修補後要以防蝕帽、密封材與防水塗層形成多道屏障，並保留可檢查的觀察孔。~Not every tendon with a void needs replacement: where wires are sound but the grout is incomplete, vacuum-assisted injection first evacuates the void and then fills it with low-bleed grout or resin, cutting off water and oxygen. After the 2000 event, Mid-Bay's anchorage voids were vacuum-regrouted, and later rehabilitation also included tendon wrapping and anchorage protection. Anchorages are the likeliest entry points for water, so repairs should build several barriers with protective caps, sealants and waterproof coatings and keep an inspectable port.
units.model: 真空體積法以波以耳定律量空隙：真空槽 V_t = 20 L 抽至 0.1 bar（絕對壓力），接上空隙（初始 1.0 bar），平衡後 0.4 bar。0.1×20 + 1.0×V = 0.4×(20 + V)，得 V = 10 L；若 100 mm 套管頂部空隙截面約 2,000 mm²，空隙長度約 5 m。數值為教學假設。~Vacuum volumetry measures a void with Boyle's law: a 20 L tank evacuated to 0.1 bar absolute is connected to a void initially at 1.0 bar, and the pressures equalise at 0.4 bar. 0.1×20 + 1.0×V = 0.4×(20 + V) gives V = 10 L; if the void at the top of a 100 mm duct has a cross-section of about 2,000 mm², it is about 5 m long. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 灌注前以真空體積法量測空隙體積，灌注後與實際注入量比對，兩者差異過大代表有洩漏路徑或沒有填滿；完成後從原檢查孔再以內視鏡確認，並對錨頭保護帽做壓力或氣密試驗。~Measure the void volume by vacuum volumetry before injection and compare it with the volume actually injected; a large difference signals a leak path or incomplete filling. Afterwards re-check through the original holes with a borescope and pressure- or air-test the anchor caps.
units.failure: 若在已有大量斷絲的鋼腱上只做真空灌注，等於把損傷封起來看不見，鋼腱仍可能在數年後斷裂；灌注材料與舊灌漿不相容，或殘留水分沒有排出，也可能在界面持續腐蝕。~Vacuum-injecting a tendon that already has many broken wires only seals the damage out of sight, and the tendon may still rupture years later; a filler incompatible with the old grout, or moisture left trapped, can keep corroding at the interface.
units.misconception: 真空灌注可以讓已腐蝕的鋼腱恢復原來的強度。~Vacuum injection restores a corroded tendon to its original strength.
units.practice: 修補與更換的分界要事先定義，例如 MFL 或開窗顯示截面損失超過設定比例、或已有斷絲的鋼腱一律更換，只有鋼絲完好的空隙才做灌注；判定準則由業主的結構工程師核定並寫入維護手冊。~Define the line between repair and replacement in advance, for example replacing any tendon whose MFL or opening shows section loss above a set fraction or any broken wires, and injecting only voids with sound wires; the owner's structural engineer approves the criteria and writes them into the maintenance manual.

units.anchor: 聲射監測與鋼腱履歷~Acoustic emission and tendon records
units.title: 長期監測、紀錄與交接~Long-term monitoring, records and handover
units.mechanism: 鋼絲斷裂會釋放瞬間應力波，可被聲射（AE）感測器捕捉，因此在高風險跨段佈設感測器，就能即時記錄斷絲事件的時間與位置。FHWA 報告指出 Varina-Enon 橋在 2020 年 10 月裝設聲射監測，並稱其為偵測即時斷絲最經濟的技術；Wando River 橋則在更換鋼腱後加設兩條外置鋼腱以提高冗餘。交接時要留下每條鋼腱的履歷：材料批號、張拉與伸長量紀錄、灌漿或填充材、頻率基準、檢測孔位置與修補紀錄。~A wire break releases a transient stress wave that acoustic emission (AE) sensors can capture, so instrumenting high-risk spans records the time and location of wire-break events in real time. FHWA reports that Varina-Enon Bridge received AE monitoring in October 2020 and calls it the most economical technology for detecting real-time wire breaks; at Wando River two extra external tendons were added after the replacement to raise redundancy. Handover must leave a history for every tendon: material heat numbers, stressing and elongation records, grout or filler, frequency baseline, inspection-hole locations and repair records.
units.model: 19 股七線鋼絞線共 19×7 = 133 根鋼絲，每斷一根約損失 1/133 ≈ 0.75% 的鋼材面積。若警戒值設在單一鋼腱 5% 面積損失，即 0.05×133 ≈ 6.65，約在第 7 次斷絲事件時發出警報。數值為教學假設。~A tendon of 19 seven-wire strands has 19×7 = 133 wires, so each break removes about 1/133 ≈ 0.75% of the steel area. An alert threshold of 5% area loss in one tendon corresponds to 0.05×133 ≈ 6.65, so the alarm is raised at about the seventh wire-break event. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 聲射系統安裝後以斷鉛試驗或校正敲擊確認每個感測器的靈敏度與定位精度，並定期檢查通訊與電源；每次警報都要經人工複核，比對事件波形、定位與交通紀錄，排除重車與伸縮縫撞擊造成的誤報。~After installing the AE system, confirm each sensor's sensitivity and location accuracy with pencil-lead breaks or calibration taps, and check communications and power regularly; every alert needs a manual review comparing waveform, location and traffic records to rule out false alarms from heavy trucks or expansion-joint impacts.
units.failure: 若交接文件只有竣工圖而沒有鋼腱層級的紀錄，多年後發生斷絲時，工程師無法判斷是同一灌漿批次、同一施工季節或同一細部的系統性問題，只能全面重新普查，成本與交通衝擊都被放大。~If handover leaves only as-built drawings without tendon-level records, engineers facing a wire break years later cannot tell whether it reflects a systemic problem of one grout batch, one construction season or one detail, and must resurvey everything at far greater cost and traffic impact.
units.misconception: 鋼腱更換完成後，這座橋的預力問題就徹底解決了。~Once tendons are replaced, the bridge's prestressing problems are solved for good.
units.practice: 維護手冊應包含每跨的單一鋼腱移除交通限制表、檢測週期（例如高風險跨段縮短為半年一次）、警報處置流程與聯絡窗口；任何加載變更或橋面改建前，須由結構工程師重新檢核預力冗餘。~The maintenance manual should include each span's single-tendon-removal traffic table, inspection intervals (for example six-monthly for high-risk spans), the alarm response procedure and contacts; before any load change or deck rebuild, a structural engineer must recheck prestress redundancy.

example: 設計練習：某預鑄節塊箱梁每跨 6 條 19 股 15.2 mm 外置鋼腱，每條有效預力 2.97 MN；斷面 A = 6.0 m²、S_b = 3.5 m³、e = 1.2 m，服務彎矩 M = 30 MN·m，其中恆載 22 MN·m、活載 8 MN·m。(1) 六條鋼腱時底緣 σ_b = −17.82/6.0 − 17.82×1.2/3.5 + 30/3.5 ≈ −2.97 − 6.11 + 8.57 = −0.51 MPa。(2) 去張一條後 P = 14.85 MN，底緣零應力可承受的彎矩 M_0 = S_b·(P/A + P·e/S_b) = 3.5×(2.475 + 5.091) ≈ 26.5 MN·m，扣除恆載 22 MN·m 後活載只能用 4.5 MN·m，約為設計活載的 56%，需要封閉車道或禁行重車。(3) 新鋼腱以 P_j ≈ 3,857 kN 張拉，μ = 0.25、α = 0.20 rad、L = 120 m，平均力約 3,763 kN，伸長量 ΔL ≈ 0.87 m，250 mm 行程需 4 次。(4) 若改變一個輸入：更換期間加裝兩支臨時預力棒共 2.0 MN、偏心相同，底緣再增加壓應力 2.0/6.0 + 2.0×1.2/3.5 ≈ 1.02 MPa，M_0 升至約 30.0 MN·m，可恢復全部活載。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。~Design exercise: a precast segmental box girder has six external tendons of 19 × 15.2 mm strands per span, each with 2.97 MN effective prestress; the section has A = 6.0 m², S_b = 3.5 m³ and e = 1.2 m, and the service moment is M = 30 MN·m, of which 22 MN·m is dead load and 8 MN·m live load. (1) With six tendons the bottom fibre is σ_b = −17.82/6.0 − 17.82×1.2/3.5 + 30/3.5 ≈ −2.97 − 6.11 + 8.57 = −0.51 MPa. (2) With one tendon detensioned, P = 14.85 MN and the moment at zero bottom stress is M_0 = S_b·(P/A + P·e/S_b) = 3.5×(2.475 + 5.091) ≈ 26.5 MN·m; after 22 MN·m of dead load only 4.5 MN·m of live load remains, about 56% of the design live load, so lanes must be closed or heavy vehicles banned. (3) The new tendon is stressed to P_j ≈ 3,857 kN with μ = 0.25, α = 0.20 rad and L = 120 m; the average force is about 3,763 kN and the elongation ΔL ≈ 0.87 m, needing 4 strokes of 250 mm. (4) Changing one input: adding two temporary prestressing bars totalling 2.0 MN at the same eccentricity adds 2.0/6.0 + 2.0×1.2/3.5 ≈ 1.02 MPa of bottom compression, raising M_0 to about 30.0 MN·m so full live load can return. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
history: 外置鋼腱的預鑄節塊箱梁在 1980 至 1990 年代廣泛用於美國的跨水與高架橋，1993 年通車、長約 5.8 km 的佛州 Mid-Bay 大橋即屬此類。1999 年佛州 Niles Channel 橋出現美國第一起確認由腐蝕造成的鋼腱失效，2000 年 Mid-Bay 大橋接著發現斷裂鋼腱，FDOT 研擬逐股切斷的去張程序並更換 11 條鋼腱；之後 Ringling 堤道橋在 2011 年更換 17 條鋼腱，Wando River 橋在 2016 與 2018 年兩度出現鋼腱失效。這些事件推動了灌漿材料與規範改進、2019 年 FHWA 可更換灌漿外置鋼腱指引，以及 2024 年 FHWA 腐蝕導致鋼腱失效的彙整報告。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Precast segmental box girders with external tendons were widely used for American water crossings and viaducts in the 1980s and 1990s, including Florida's Mid-Bay Bridge, about 5.8 km long and opened in 1993. In 1999 Florida's Niles Channel Bridge had the first confirmed corrosion-caused tendon failure in the United States; in 2000 broken tendons were found at Mid-Bay, where FDOT devised a strand-by-strand detensioning procedure and replaced 11 tendons. Ringling Causeway Bridge later had 17 tendons replaced in 2011, and Wando River Bridge suffered tendon failures in 2016 and 2018. These events drove improved grout materials and specifications, FHWA's 2019 guide to replaceable grouted external tendons and FHWA's 2024 compilation on corrosion-induced tendon failures. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: Mid-Bay 大橋全長約 5.8 km（19,265 ft），1993 年通車，典型跨徑約 136 ft、主跨 225 ft~Mid-Bay Bridge is about 5.8 km (19,265 ft) long, opened in 1993, with typical spans of about 136 ft and a 225 ft main span
Mid-Bay 每條外置鋼腱為 19 股 0.6 in（15.2 mm）、270 ksi 鋼絞線，置於 4 in 聚乙烯套管內，每跨 6 條~Each Mid-Bay external tendon has 19 strands of 0.6 in (15.2 mm), 270 ksi steel in a 4 in polyethylene duct, six tendons per span
2000 年事件後 FDOT 以內視鏡檢查全部 1,728 個錨頭，並更換 846 條鋼腱中的 11 條~After the 2000 event FDOT borescoped all 1,728 anchorages and replaced 11 of 846 tendons
Mid-Bay 第 28 跨一條鋼腱 19 股中有 6 股被腐蝕切斷，殘餘力估計約 500 kips（約 2,220 kN）~One Mid-Bay span 28 tendon had 6 of 19 strands severed by corrosion and an estimated residual force of about 500 kips (about 2,220 kN)

Ringling 堤道橋 2003 年完工，132 條 22 股外置鋼腱中有 2 條在不到 8 年內失效，最終更換 17 條~Ringling Causeway Bridge, completed in 2003, had 2 of its 132 external 22-strand tendons fail within 8 years, and 17 were eventually replaced

Wando River 橋 2018 年失效的鋼腱 133 根鋼絲中約 80.5% 因腐蝕斷裂，西行橋封閉近 3 週~In the tendon that failed at Wando River Bridge in 2018, about 80.5% of 133 wires had ruptured by corrosion, and the westbound bridge closed for nearly 3 weeks

FHWA-HIF-19-067 建議 19 股鋼腱最小轉向半徑約 9.8 ft，擴口出口角取轉向角加 3°~FHWA-HIF-19-067 recommends a minimum deviator radius of about 9.8 ft for 19-strand tendons and a diabolo exit angle of the deviation angle plus 3°

AASHTO LRFD 節塊橋修訂條文（預定納入第 10 版）要求臨時預力容量不少於總預力的 5%，未來追加鋼腱選項為 10%~Revised AASHTO LRFD segmental provisions (slated for the 10th edition) require provisional capacity of at least 5% of total prestress, with a 10% option for future tendons

sources.title: FHWA：後拉預力混凝土橋腐蝕導致之重大鋼腱失效（FHWA-HRT-24-148）
sources.titleEn: FHWA: Corrosion-Induced Major Tendon Failures in Post-Tension Concrete Bridges (FHWA-HRT-24-148)
sources.scope: 彙整 Mid-Bay、Ringling、Wando River、Varina-Enon 等橋的失效年份、鋼腱規格、原因與更換數量；課程計算另為教學假設。
sources.scopeEn: Compiles failure years, tendon sizes, causes and replacement counts for Mid-Bay, Ringling, Wando River, Varina-Enon and other bridges; course calculations are separate teaching assumptions.

sources.title: FHWA：可更換灌漿外置後拉鋼腱（FHWA-HIF-19-067）
sources.titleEn: FHWA: Replaceable Grouted External Post-Tensioned Tendons (FHWA-HIF-19-067)
sources.scope: 說明雙層包覆、擴口轉向、最小半徑、張拉淨空與去張注意事項的設計指引。
sources.scopeEn: Design guide covering the double-envelope concept, diabolo deviators, minimum radii, stressing clearances and detensioning considerations.

sources.title: FDOT：外置預力鋼腱去張（Mid-Bay 大橋案例）
sources.titleEn: FDOT: Detensioning an External Prestressing Tendon (Mid-Bay Bridge case)
sources.scope: FDOT 工程師記錄 2000 年 Mid-Bay 鋼腱去張的方法比較、切斷順序、夾具與殘餘力估計；不構成作業許可。
sources.scopeEn: FDOT engineers' account of detensioning a Mid-Bay tendon in 2000, comparing methods, cutting sequence, clamps and residual-force estimate; not an operating permit.

sources.title: FHWA：後拉預力孔道缺陷灌漿取樣、評估與修復指引（FHWA-HRT-13-028）
sources.titleEn: FHWA: Guidelines for Sampling, Assessing, and Restoring Defective Grout in Post-Tensioning Ducts (FHWA-HRT-13-028)
sources.scope: 灌漿缺陷類型、統計抽樣數量、取樣位置與修復方法的決策流程。
sources.scopeEn: Decision process for grout deficiency types, statistically based sample sizes, sampling locations and restoration methods.

sources.title: Corven Engineering：Mid-Bay 大橋預力系統評估

sources.scopeEn: Consultant project page describing inspection, analysis, load rating and rehabilitation items after two tendon failures were found in 2000, with basic bridge data.
